Key.Original:
Press [8] to close.
Press 2x[8] to open in field manual.
Key.Chinesesimp:
按[8]关闭.
按2次[8]在战地手册中打开.

Key.Original: The enemy is preparing a counterattack, hold the zone at all costs.
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人正在准备反击，不惜一切代价守住区域。

Key.Original: The enemy will launch their attack soon. Set up defenses.
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人很快就会发动攻击。设置防御。

Key.Original: Defend the zone until all hostiles have been eliminated.
Key.Chinesesimp: 防守区域直到所有敌人被消灭。

Key.Original: The enemy is preparing to attack an FOB. Prepare to defend it!
Key.Chinesesimp: 敌人正在准备攻击一个基地。准备防御！

Key.Original: The task list in the task roster shows you the tasks currently assigned to your team. Support tasks and other objectives will also be shown when they're available. Tasks can also be viewed in the map screen.
Key.Chinesesimp: 任务列表显示当前分配给团队的各项任务。当任务可用时，支援任务和其他目标也会显示。任务也可以在地图屏幕中查看。

Key.Original: <t size='0.6' font='tt2020base_vn'>Description for current Medal or Ribbon shown. More textspace blablabla roflcopter blub bla, i like trains and more stuff to add omgwtf stuff thingy</t>
Key.Chinesesimp: <t size='0.6' font='tt2020base_vn'>当前勋章或绶带的描述。</t>

Key.Original: Bring the Iron Rain! The Radio Telephone Operator is critical to providing heavy fire support to the team. As an RTO you have the power to control the battlefield through a variety of air and artillery strikes. Illuminations are key to being able to operate during the night. You'll need a radio backpack though in order to call for support!
Key.Chinesesimp: 带来铁雨！无线电操作员是提供重火力支援队伍的关键。作为一个RTO，你有能力通过各种空中和炮兵打击来控制战场。照明弹是夜间行动的关键。不过，你需要一个无线电背包才能呼叫支援！

Key.Original:
Situation rooms are the heart of an FOB. They connect all of the surrounding buildings to a single supply pool, and enable the building of FOB specific structures. Most of the building you do should be part of an FOB!
To build a situation room, open the build menu with the N key (default) and then select 'Feature: HQ' as a category. Building an FOB near to existing structures will automatically make them part of the FOB.
Key.Chinesesimp:
战情室是FOB的核心。它们将周围的所有建筑物连接到一个单一的物资池，并允许建造特定于FOB的结构。你做的大多数建筑都应该是FOB的一部分！
要建造一个战情室，使用N键（默认）打开建造菜单，然后选择“功能：HQ”作为类别。在现有结构附近建造一个FOB将自动使它们成为FOB的一部分。

Key.Original: Medical tents are vital to ensuring your team can stay in the fight. They enable your team to heal up at the FOB, without consuming precious first aid kits.
Key.Chinesesimp: 医疗帐篷对于确保你的团队是否能够继续战斗至关重要。它们使你的团队可以在FOB处治疗，而不会消耗宝贵的急救包。

Key.Original: The building next to you is a checkpoint. You can respawn at these buildings, although that depletes the building's supplies. Running out of supplies will disable redeployment to that checkpoint, so remember to keep resupplying to ensure you can always get back in the fight.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你附近的建筑物是一个检查点。你可以在这些建筑物处重生，尽管这会消耗建筑物的物资。物资耗尽将禁用对该检查点的重新部署，所以请记住要不断补给以确保你总是能够重新加入战斗。

Key.Original: Engineers can place building and structures to help their team. Engineers on ACAV have access to more structures than engineers on other teams. To start building, open the building menu using the N key (default).
Key.Chinesesimp: 工程师可以放置建筑和结构来帮助他们的团队。装甲骑兵的工程师比其他团队的工程师有更多的建筑可供选择。要开始建造，使用N键（默认）打开建造菜单。

Key.Original: Mike Force, attack and clear those objectives! Mike Force's primary mission is to clear hostiles from the zone and eliminate enemy sites such as AA and artillery. You'll be in the thick of it, supported by ACAV on the ground and Green Hornets in the air.
Key.Chinesesimp: 机动打击部队，攻击并清除那些目标！机动打击部队的主要任务是清除该地区的敌人并消灭敌方的AA和炮兵阵地。你将身处战斗之中，由装甲骑兵在地面和绿色大黄蜂在空中提供支援。

Key.Original: Mike Force, attack and clear those objectives.
Key.Chinesesimp: 机动打击部队，攻击并清除那些目标。

Key.Original: You'll never get anywhere without a base. With unlimited numbers of engineers, ACAV are perfectly positioned to build all of the necessary structures to allow all your team to capture, hold and deploy from the current zone. ACAV also fill the role of heavy fire support on the ground, wading into battle with tanks and gun trucks.
Key.Chinesesimp: 没有基地，你将无处可去。装甲骑兵拥有无限的工程师，他们非常适合建造所有必要的建筑，以允许你的队伍占领、防守并从当前区域部署。装甲骑兵还是地面重火力支援的重要角色，他们驾驶坦克和卡车深入战场。
装甲骑兵，建设，补给，胜利！

Key.Original: Transport, supplies and CAS. These are the primary mission goals of Green Hornets. As a pilot for the Green Hornets, you should prioritise getting people to where they need to go, as well as providing critical supplies to distant outposts. However, when your team calls a Prairie Fire emergency - don't hesitate to provide some heavy fire support!
Key.Chinesesimp: 运输，补给和空对地支援。这些是绿色大黄蜂的主要任务目标。作为绿色大黄蜂的飞行员，你应该优先将人送到他们需要去的地方，并为远处的哨所提供关键的补给。然而，当你的团队呼叫草原之火(Prairie Fire)紧急支援时，不要犹豫，提供重火力支援！

Key.Original: Green Hornets, Supply, Transport and CAS.
Key.Chinesesimp: 绿色大黄蜂，补给，运输和空对地支援。

Key.Original: Welcome to the Mike Force tutorial. As you play, these survival cards will show up to provide you with helpful hints about the various aspects of the gamemode. Cards be re-read in the Field Manual, accessible from the escape menu. The tutorial can be disabled in the gamemode settings menu.
Key.Chinesesimp: 欢迎来到Mike Force教程。随着你游戏，这些生存卡会显示出来，为你提供关于游戏模式各种方面的有用提示。卡片可以在战地手册中重新阅读，可通过ESC菜单访问。教程可以在游戏模式设置菜单中禁用。

Key.Original: As a member of one of four elite units, your mission is to capture and hold all of the marked areas in Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia through any means necessary.
Key.Chinesesimp: 作为四个精英单位之一的成员，你的任务是占领并守住越南，老挝和柬埔寨的所有标记区域，无论采取何种手段。

Key.Original: The task roster is your first point of contact in Mike Force, accessed by pressing the H key (default). Here you can select your team, track your tasks, request support and check your rank and medals.
Key.Chinesesimp: 任务簿是你在机动打击部队中首先需要了解的，通过按下H键（默认）访问。在这里，你可以选择你的团队，跟踪你的任务，请求支援，并检查你的军衔和勋章。

Key.Original: You can gear up by accessing an arsenal at one of the main bases. Make sure you grab some food and water, first aid kits and a shovel for building. Take as much gear as you can carry: you dont want to run out of bullets in the middle of a firefight!
Key.Chinesesimp: 你可以在主要基地之一的一个军火库中装备自己。确保你先拿一些食物和水，急救包和一把铲子来建造。尽可能多地携带装备：你不会想在枪战中将子弹用完！

Key.Original: Fast travel is a quick way to travel around the main US bases for each team. You can fast travel by standing next to the map stand in game and pressing the 6 key (default). Travelling in this way is free and instant!
Key.Chinesesimp: 快速旅行是快速访问每个团队的美军基地的一种方式。你可以通过站在游戏中的地图架旁并按下6键（默认）来快速旅行。以这种方式旅行是免费的，并且是即时的！

Key.Original: Construction! To start building, open the building menu using the N key (default). You will see the available buildings and objects on the left hand menu, and a description of each building or object on the right. Most buildings can only be built when certain conditions are met!
Key.Chinesesimp: 建造！要开始建造，使用N键（默认）打开建造菜单。你将在左侧菜单中看到可用的建筑物和物体，以及每个建筑物或物体的描述。大多数建筑物只有在满足特定条件时才能建造！

Key.Original: You're now placing a building! While placing, you can adjust position, height and rotation by using the left and right mouse buttons to cycle through different modes. Then the ghost building is green, you can place it by using the 'Build' hold action.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你现在正在放置一个建筑物！在放置过程中，你可以使用鼠标左键和右键来循环不同的模式，调整位置，高度和旋转。当建筑蓝图是绿色时，你可以使用“建造”动作来放置它。

Key.Original: When a building is placed, it is only partially built. To finish construction, you need to equip a shovel from the arsenal and use it on the building. After several hits, the building will be finished.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当一个建筑物被放置后，它只是部分建造。要完成建造，你需要从军火库中装备一把铲子，并在建筑物上使用它。经过几次打击后，建筑物将被完成。

Key.Original: Buildings and constructed objects require building supplies to prevent them from decaying. To resupply a building, you'll need a resupply crate nearby or sandbags in your inventory. Then open the building's wheel menu with 6 (default) and press resupply. Buildings that are of an FOB share the same supplies, while standalone buildings have their own supply pool.
Key.Chinesesimp: 建筑物和构造物需要建筑物资以防止它们衰败。要为建筑物补充物资，你需要附近有补货箱或库存中的沙袋。然后使用6（默认）打开建筑轮菜单并按下补充。属于FOB的建筑物共享相同的物资，而独立的建筑物有自己的物资池。

Key.Original: When a building runs out of supplies, it begins to decay! A decaying building will be destroyed when no players are nearby. These buildings are also inactive - special features such as respawning or vehicle creation will be disabled.
Key.Chinesesimp: 当建筑耗尽物资时，它开始衰败！当附近没有玩家时，衰败的建筑物将被摧毁。这些建筑物也是不活动的——特殊功能，如重生或车辆创建将被禁用。

Key.Original: Close Air Support. When providing close air support as Green Hornets, remember to only engage targets designated by support tasks. Helping the team is your main job, getting kills is not.
Key.Chinesesimp: 近距空中支援。当作为绿色大黄蜂提供近距空中支援时，请记住只攻击支援任务指定的目标。帮助队伍是你的主要工作，击杀不是。

Key.Original: Request CAS on targets at a specific location
Key.Chinesesimp: 在指定位置请求近距空中支援

Key.Original: Destroy enemy units in this area.
Key.Chinesesimp: 摧毁此区域内的敌方单位。

Key.Original: Rescue the crew of the downed helicopter, %1.
Key.Chinesesimp: 营救坠毁的直升机机组人员, %1。

Key.Original: Request reinforcement and extraction from a specific position
Key.Chinesesimp: 请求从指定位置进行增援和撤离

Key.Original: Find the stranded crew of the downed helicopter at the position they've specified.
Key.Chinesesimp: 找到指定位置坠毁的直升机上的机组人员。

Key.Original: Protect the stranded crew until they're safely back at base.
Key.Chinesesimp: 保护被困的机组人员，直到他们安全地回到基地。

Key.Original: %1 has requested you destroy the gun emplacements at this position.
Request the gun emplacements in this area be destroyed.
Key.Chinesesimp: 请求摧毁此区域的炮台。

Key.Original: Destroy all weapon emplacements within 50m of this position.
Key.Chinesesimp: 摧毁此位置50米范围内的所有武器阵地。

Key.Original:
The Viet Cong controls this province.
Your Mobile Strike Force must take control of the populace and destroy the Viet Congs jungle sanctuaries.

- There are 10 zones to capture and hold.
- You can operate in 2 zones at the same time.
There are 4 teams:
- Mike Force; ACAV; Green Hornets; and Spike Team.
- Teams work together on Primary Tasks to help capture a zone.
- Your team - (insert name here) - has unique Team Tasks which help capture a zone. Change teams in the lobby.
- You can get support from other teams with Request Support (Hyperlink?).
- Your team can complete Support Tasks for the other teams.
- Completing Team and Support Tasks helps you gain rank.
- Higher ranks can access improved weapons, equipment and vehicles.
- Working together as a unified force will secure the province more quickly.
- So choose your team. Good luck out there, you’re going to need it!
Key.Chinesesimp:
越南人民军控制了这个省。
你的机动突击部队必须控制民众并摧毁越南共产党的丛林避难所。

- 有 10 个区域需要占领并守住。
- 你可以同时操作 2 个区域。
有 4 个队伍：
- 机动打击部队; 装甲骑兵小队; 绿色大黄蜂小队 和 尖刀小队.
- 队伍们一起完成主要任务来帮助占领一个区域。
- 你的队伍 - (插入名字) - 有独特的队伍任务，帮助占领一个区域。在大厅里可更换队伍。
- 你可以通过请求支援从其他队伍获得支援。
- 你的队伍可以为其他队伍完成支援任务。
- 完成队伍和支援任务可以帮助你获得军衔。
- 更高的军衔可以让你获得更高级的武器，装备和载具。
- 作为统一的部队一起工作可以更快地占领这个省。
- 请选择你的队伍。祝你好运，你将需要它！

Key.Original: You toggled on the interaction overlay.
Key.Chinesesimp: 你打开了互动覆显界面。

Key.Original:
As special forces infantry, your team's role is to:
- Sweep and clear areas of enemy
- Secure and hold zones
- Protect populations, logistics and supplies
- Reinforce other teams
Tasks
- Primary Tasks are shared by all teams.
- Secondary Tasks are unique to your team.
- Support Tasks are called by other teams in need of your help. You may also request their support, for example transport is provided for you by ACAV or Green Hornets.
Key.Chinesesimp:
作为特种部队步兵，你的小队职责是：
- 扫荡并清除敌区
- 夺取和守住防区
- 保护人口、物流和供应
- 增援其他小队
任务
- 主要任务由所有团队共享。
- 次要任务仅对你的小队。
- 支持任务由需要你帮助的其他团队呼叫。你也可以请求他们的支持，例如由装甲骑兵或绿蜂提供运输。

Key.Original:
As special forces recon, your team's role is to:
- Carry out reconnaissance to locate enemy infrastructure
- Ambush and assault the enemy
- Direct air and armour support onto enemy concentrations
- Support other teams with reconnaissance and search and rescue
Tasks
- Primary Tasks are shared by all teams.
- Secondary Tasks are unique to your team.
- Support Tasks are called by other teams in need of your help. You may also request their support, for example transport is provided for you by ACAV or Green Hornets.
Key.Chinesesimp:
作为特种部队侦察兵，你的小队职责是：
- 执行侦察以定位敌方基础设施
- 伏击和突击敌人
- 引导空中和装甲支援直接到敌人的集中地
- 通过侦察和搜索救援为其他团队提供支持
任务
- 主要任务由所有团队共享。
- 次要任务仅对你的小队。
- 支持任务由需要你帮助的其他团队呼叫。你也可以请求他们的支持，例如由装甲骑兵或绿蜂提供运输。

Key.Original:
As a Green Hornet, your team's role is to fly helicopters and jets to:
- Insert and extract troops to their desired location
- Carry out aerial reconnaissance to find enemy infrastructure
- Support other teams with close air support
- Deliver supplies to build new infrastructure
- Engage enemy aircraft
Tasks
- Primary Tasks are shared by all teams.
- Secondary Tasks are unique to your team.
- Support Tasks are called by other teams in need of your help. You may also request their support, for example search and rescue is provided for you by Spike Team.
Key.Chinesesimp:
作为绿蜂部队，你的小队的职责是驾驶直升机和喷气式飞机：
- 将部队投放或撤离到他们想要的位置
- 进行空中侦察以查找敌方基础设施
- 通过对地空中支持为其他团队提供支援
- 运送物资以构建新的基础设施
- 与敌机交战
任务
- 主要任务由所有团队共享。
- 次要任务仅对你的小队。
- 支持任务由需要你帮助的其他团队呼叫。你也可以请求他们的支持，例如由尖刀小队提供搜索救援。

Key.Original:
As Armoured Cavalry, your team's role is to operate trucks and tanks to:
- Insert and extract troops to their desired location
- Support other teams with heavy weapons vehicles
- Deliver supplies and build new infrastructure
- Engage enemy vehicles and armour
Tasks
- Primary Tasks are shared by all teams.
- Secondary Tasks are unique to your team.
- Support Tasks are called by other teams in need of your help. You may also request their support, for example vehicle recovery or convoy protection is provided for you by Green Hornets.
Key.Chinesesimp:
作为装甲骑兵，您的团队的职责是操作卡车和坦克：
- 将部队投放或撤离到他们想要的位置
-使用重型武器载具支持其他团队
- 运送物资并构建新的基础设施
- 与敌方载具和装甲交战
任务
- 主要任务由所有团队共享。
- 次要任务仅对你的小队。
- 支持任务由需要你帮助的其他团队呼叫。你也可以请求他们的支持，例如，由绿蜂为您提供载具恢复或保护。
